title: TJ Monterde joins line-up for South Korea’s ROUND Festival

blocks.text: Filipino singer-songwriter TJ Monterde is set to represent the Philippines on the international stage after joining the official lineup of artists for South Korea’s ROUND Festival. The annual ASEAN-Korea Music Festival announced its headliners this week. The event confirmed that the “Palagi” hitmaker will share the stage with prominent acts from Southeast Asia and South Korea.
